csv_project_name: Design for STH 35 Tower Avenue Resurfacing
csv_agency: State of Wisconsin Dept of Trans Div Of Hwys
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Wisconsin , may be seeking a Consultant to provide Design for Perpetuation project to resurface approximately 4.05 miles of STH 35/Tower Avenue from 64th Street to Belknap Street in the City of Superior in Douglas County. Design a 1.5 inch concrete mill and 2.75 inch asphalt overlay. Additional work includes doweled concrete pavement repairs, cleaning & patching concrete joints, railroad crossing surface replacement by railroad company, traffic signals replacements at 4 intersections, temporary traffic signals, adding raised medians with plantings, adding curb bump outs, spot sidewalk repairs, spot curb & gutter repairs, adjusting utility covers, drainage inlet repairs, upgrade/review all curb ramps, and pavement markings. The work will be done under traffic utilizing single-lane closures and lane closures with flagging operation for resurfacing work, detour of traffic for railroad crossing work, temporary traffic signals, and temporary pedestrian accommodations
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering
csv_comments: '* * * ADVANCE NOTICE * * *Project Info: Solicitation ID: NW-02- Project No: 8010-00-03- The RFQ/RFP package is expected to be available prior to 06/01/2026- IMS requests NO PHONE CALLS, NO FAXES, and NO CONTACT with agency at this time.

Construction staging includes single-lane closures, flagging operations, detours for railroad crossing work, and temporary pedestrian accommodations.
